build: v136 Private Repo Command Runner Pack
runnerKpis: How ready the real private repo command session is to run without improvising.
Day-one command blocks from preflight through branch protection closeout.
Evidence paths that must be created, updated, or intentionally deferred.
Public repo, secret, workbook, or commercial data leak stops execution immediately.
preflightCommands: The output must show the expected GitHub identity before any repository action.
Tool versions are written to the preflight transcript.
The local folder is captured before copy or setup steps begin.
No Excel workbook, secret, certificate, payment key, invoice, or customer file may enter the private repo.
Repo opening approval must exist before creating the private repo.
Screenshots and transcripts need a named destination before commands start.
commandRunbook: Preflight
PowerShell: gh auth status; git --version; node --version; npm --version
Confirms local operator identity and basic tooling before any repo action. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/00-preflight-auth.txt.
blue
Create private repo
GitHub CLI: gh repo create dhirajnyse/pursuitdesk-platform --private --description PursuitDesk-production-backend --confirm
Creates the private production backend repository; capture visibility proof immediately. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/01-private-repo.txt.
red
Clone and branch
Git: git clone git@github.com:dhirajnyse/pursuitdesk-platform.git; cd pursuitdesk-platform; git checkout -b codex/backend-alpha-shell
Keeps main clean and starts all work on a reviewable branch. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/02-branch.txt.
teal
Create shell folders
PowerShell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force apps/api/src packages/domain packages/db infra docs/evidence .github/workflows scripts
Creates the minimum repo skeleton for backend alpha work. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/03-file-tree.txt.
green
Copy starter files
Manual controlled copy: Copy only approved root, API, package, workflow, env-example, script, and evidence files from the generated packs.
Moves generated shell files only; no Excel source files, secrets, or live credentials. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/04-clean-copy-set.txt.
amber
Install and first proof
Package manager: npm install; npm run lint; npm run test -- --runInBand
Runs available proof commands or records exact placeholders linked to issues if scripts are not ready. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/05-quality-proof.txt.
blue
Import taxonomy
GitHub CLI: Create labels and milestones from the taxonomy pack, then capture the labels and milestones screens.
Makes issue routing visible before backlog import. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/06-taxonomy-import.txt.
teal
Open issue wave
GitHub CLI: Open the first M0/M1 wave from generated issue bodies and record each URL in evidence.
Creates traceability before the first PR is opened. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/07-issue-wave.txt.
green
Open first PR
GitHub CLI: git add .; git commit -m "Backend alpha shell"; git push -u origin codex/backend-alpha-shell; gh pr create --draft --title "Backend alpha shell" --body-file docs/evidence/first-pr.md
Creates a draft first PR with proof, rollback, risk reference, and reviewer lanes. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/08-first-pr.txt.
amber
Closeout and protect main
GitHub settings: Capture workflow check names after the first Actions run, then apply branch protection only with real check names.
Ends with branch protection proof, owner signoffs, blockers, and next owner. Save output or blocker note to docs/evidence/transcripts/09-closeout.txt.
red

handoff: v136 turns the evidence folder writer and day-one script into a private repo command runner pack.
The pack names preflight commands, command order, expected outputs, evidence write paths, screenshot slots, owner prompts, branch-protection timing, closeout checks, and copy-ready commands.
It deliberately does not execute against GitHub from the static demo; it prepares the exact run sheet for the real private backend repository session.
v137 can now define the backend PR review gate matrix so reviewers know what to approve, hold, or block after the command runner produces evidence.
